_what: The events a chat app subscribed to Trillion's MCP server is sent when work moves (MCP Events, protocol 2026-07-28, webhook delivery; src/mcp-events.mjs). One row per event: its stable name, what it says, which handoff moments (src/agents.mjs tell) make it, the subscription arguments (inputSchema) and the shape of what is delivered (payloadSchema, filled from the handoff fields it names). `agent_argument` names the argument that picks work by agent id and `agent_field` the handoff field it is compared with; without it, the event goes to the AI that subscribed (its reader). `anyone_argument` names the argument that also takes work handed to whichever AI takes it first (the moments in `anyone_moments`). A new event is one row here; nothing that sends events changes.

events.name: work.waiting
events.label: Work is handed to one of my AIs
events.description: Work was handed to the published agent named in agent_id (publish this chat with publish_agent first, and use its agent_id) in the person's Trillion. The event names the handoff; read it with read_handoff, take it with take_work and finish it with finish_work.

agent_id.description: The published agent whose work starts this chat (an agent_id from publish_agent or find_agents). Several apps can sign in under the same app name, so work is picked by agent, never by app name.

include_work_for_anyone.description: Also work handed to whichever of the person's AIs takes it first.

events.name: work.finished
events.label: Work I handed off is finished
events.description: Work this AI handed off (or that the agent named in agent_id handed off) was finished. Read the result with read_handoff.

agent_id.description: Only work this published agent handed off. Left out: work this chat handed off.

events.name: work.stuck
events.label: Work I handed off is stuck
events.description: An AI said something is in the way of work this AI (or the agent named in agent_id) handed off. Read it with read_handoff.

agent_id.description: Only work this published agent handed off. Left out: work this chat handed off.
